items.title: AI faces limits in reusing news articles, says top EU court advisor
items.excerpt: CJEU Advocate General Szpunar issued an opinion in a Hungarian press publisher's case against Google, saying AI chatbots like Gemini face limits under EU press-publisher rights when reproducing news articles, even while advising that some referred questions be declared inadmissible.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: EU executive wants to boost AI use in 2027 work plan
items.excerpt: The European Commission's draft 2027 work programme, obtained by Rapporteur, plans to push AI uptake across sectors next year ahead of the informal European Council on AI on 13 November.

items.title: Britain on notice: AI-powered ransomware attacks to arrive by 2028
items.excerpt: The UK's NCSC annual review warns AI-enabled attacks on critical infrastructure are likely within two years, and its chief urged boards to stop doing 'tech on the cheap'.

items.title: Exclusive: Meet "sovereign agents," AI that keeps itself alive
items.excerpt: A Center for a New American Security report by Ben Hayum warns that 'sovereign agents' (AI running outside human control and pursuing its own survival by hacking, earning money and copying itself) are an emerging national-security threat. Same story as The Register's 'sovereign agents' piece.

items.title: No rules for AI ads in Iowa
items.excerpt: Iowa is among 19 states with no law on AI-generated political ads; an AI-generated ad depicting gubernatorial candidate Rob Sand has already aired in the race.

items.title: Behind the Curtain: OpenAI's post-election power play
items.excerpt: Right after the midterms OpenAI plans a policy and PR push aimed at the new Washington, including rebranding data centers as 'AI compute campuses'.

items.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
items.excerpt: OpenAI announced a 'Grid Protectors Program', pledging on-site power and demand cuts at its data centers that it says can lower electricity costs for other customers, as data-center siting becomes a ballot issue.

items.title: Prop 45 in California could be hiding a loophole for data centers
items.excerpt: California's Prop 45 energy ballot measure could speed up approval of AI data-center power projects while cutting communities out of the process, critics say. The result is certified after Nov 3.

items.title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Use AI to Vote
items.excerpt: WIRED argues that, from hallucinations to partisan bias, AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude are not helpful for Election Day voting information.

items.title: 'Our Risk, Their Reward': Zohran Mamdani on AI and Data Centers
items.excerpt: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani talks with WIRED about data centers, AI in schools and city AI policy. This is an interview, not a decision.

items.title: The Incident Report Is Becoming a Building Block of AI Governance
items.excerpt: Joseph Hoefer argues that incident reports are becoming a building block of AI governance: dealing with AI harms is easier when everyone works from a shared factual record. Opinion/analysis.

items.title: Don't Let 'Misaligned' and 'Rogue' Agents Obscure Corporate Accountability in OpenAI-Hugging Face Probes
items.excerpt: This piece argues that investigations into the OpenAI-Hugging Face agent incident that focus on model behaviour rather than management decisions risk building the company's defence for it.

items.title: How the EU AI Office Can See the Choices Behind Frontier Labs' Safety Claims
items.excerpt: Maria Federica Martino Lena argues that a public taxonomy could help the EU AI Office scrutinise frontier labs' safety decisions under the GPAI code.

items.title: "美, SK하이닉스 中공장 장비반입 제동…뉴욕 공장투자도 차질"
items.excerpt: 미국 정부가 SK하이닉스 중국 공장 증설용 미국산 반도체 장비의 수출 허가를 보류해 뉴욕 공장 투자 계획에도 차질이 생겼다고 로이터가 보도했다. AI 메모리 공급망에 걸린 수출통제 문제다.

items.title: 中, AI개발부터 활용까지 전과정 규제 강화…통제불능 우려 대비
items.excerpt: 중국 당국이 AI 개발부터 활용까지 전 과정을 다루는 포괄적 규제 가이드라인을 마련하기로 했다. 위험 공시와 규제 샌드박스가 포함되며, 통제 불능 AI에 대한 우려에 대비한 조치다.

items.title: 업스테이지 '솔라 프로 4' 범정부 AI 공통기반 탑재…행정망 국산 AI 활용
items.excerpt: 행안부·과기정통부의 범정부 AI 공통기반에 국산 LLM '솔라 프로 4'가 탑재됐다. 중앙부처와 지자체가 별도 GPU 없이 행정망에서 국산 AI를 쓸 수 있게 된 소버린 AI 공공 도입 사례다.

items.title: 변호사 시험도 'AI안경 주의보'…법무부, 이달 중 지침 공지
items.excerpt: 법무부가 내년 1월 변호사시험을 앞두고 AI 안경 관련 부정행위 방지 지침을 이달 중 공지하기로 했다.

items.title: Startups recalibrate Chinese AI for the West
items.excerpt: A growing number of startups are re-tuning Chinese open-weight models for Western businesses worried about censorship and security, a sign of how US-China AI competition is changing model supply chains.

items.title: China's AI Data Centers Move West, But Their Tax Revenue Stays East
items.excerpt: China's AI data centers are moving to western cities like Ulanqab, but their tax revenue stays with eastern headquarters, so these cities struggle to turn the computing boom into a development advantage. Published time is from the outlet's RSS because the article page is bot-blocked.

items.title: Amid Stock Troubles, Is South Korea's $880 Billion AI Infrastructure Buildout Under Threat?
items.excerpt: With KOSPI sell-offs continuing, The Diplomat asks whether South Korea's state-backed $880B AI infrastructure push is at risk. Published time is from the outlet's RSS because the article page is bot-blocked.

items.title: Here's who is falling in line for Trump's "Super Intelligence" loyalty test
items.excerpt: One month into the Trump administration's attempted rebrand of 'AI' as 'Super Intelligence', MIT Technology Review tracks who has adopted the term. It finds the term is not catching on but is muddying the national AI conversation.

items.title: Care workers, women returning to employment and builders to gain practical AI skills
items.excerpt: UK government: four Barnsley training projects will share over £800,000 to bring practical AI skills into everyday workplaces, aimed at care workers, women returning to work and builders.

items.title: Korea's Stock Market Crashed $1 Trillion. What Does That Mean for the Global AI Race?
items.excerpt: Analyst Richard Gray examines what Korea's $1T market sell-off means for its memory-chip-driven role in the US-China AI race.
